purpose: Paint the objects out of three phone backdrops whose blockers #355 removed, so the ground matches the open road around them. Same size (1672x941), lossy WebP.
tool_area8: art/backdrop-paint-out/quilt.py area8 mask-area8.json src-area8.json <out.webp> <original.webp>: area8 is filled with real road, not LaMa alone. Image quilting from clean road at about the same height in the picture (rectangles in src-area8.json, road markings excluded by colour, no source spot reused within 28 px), each 72 px patch matched against the pixels already known around it and Poisson-blended in (cv2.seamlessClone); LaMa only finishes pixels no patch reached, the outer 13 px edge of the mask and two thin patch-row seams (seams-area8.json). Same mask as the LaMa pass.
tool: elephant-and-castle and east-bridge: art/backdrop-paint-out/paint.py <area> <mask>.json <out.webp>: LaMa (big-lama via simple-lama-inpainting, CPU, Apple M5 Mac) on a crop with 96 px of context; only the 17 px-dilated mask is replaced (3 px feathered), the rest of the picture is untouched; saved as WebP quality 88, method 6.
masks: Hand-drawn polygons in full-image pixels (mask-*.json) that cover the whole painted object, not only the ground-base footprint of the removed blocker: the footprint polygon is where the object stands, the crates, tent, car and barricades rise above it.

area8.removed: tent, crate stacks, iron fence, gate post and sandbag wall at the left edge (blocker 'Left near tent and supply perimeter')

elephant-and-castle.removed: wrecked car and the wooden barricades around it (blocker 'Mid-right wreck and barriers ground base')

east-bridge.removed: burnt wreck on the bridge deck with its barrel and brazier (blocker 'Near bridge wreck ground base')

lambeth.removed: street lamp pole and the two drums it stands on at the left of the road (no blocker or depth mask: the road polygon simply stopped short of it; layout.json now has a walkable pocket there)
lambeth.sharpen: sharpen.py 1.1 0.9: luma-only unsharp mask, chroma untouched, 5x5 local min/max halo limiter, applied before the paint-out; same 1672x941; one lossy WebP save (quality 88)
lambeth.tool: quilt.py with QUILT_DILATE=9 QUILT_TEXTURE=40 QUILT_MIXED=1 QUILT_PAINT_OPEN=5 QUILT_STEP=32 QUILT_P=64 mask-lambeth.json src-lambeth.json; no torch on the Mac that session, so no LaMa pass: the Poisson blend alone finished the fill (nothing was left unreached)

south.removed: sandbag pile, ammo crate and barrel between the bus and the statue plinth (no blocker; they sealed the walk to the Elephant and Castle exit, see world/south-clears). quilt.py with QUILT_EXCLUDE_YELLOW=1 art/backdrop-paint-out/quilt.py south mask-south.json src-south.json <out.webp> <original.webp>: the graded south picture is dark, so the yellow road lines are excluded from the source patches by hue as well (the env switch leaves the area8 recipe unchanged); no LaMa seams (seams-south.json is empty). paint.py takes an optional 4th argument, the source picture.

layouts: The depth mask of each painted-out object is removed from layout.json (area8 'Left near tent and supply perimeter', elephant-and-castle 'Mid-right wreck with barriers', east-bridge 'Near bridge wreck'): a depth mask hides a player standing behind the object, and the object is gone.
desktop: Only the phone copy is registered in areas.json; the original backdrop.png/backdrop.webp files are not referenced at runtime and stay untouched.

east-bridge-south.removed: wooden barricade, crates, red-white barrier and hedgehog in the middle of the road (blocker 'Mid-right supply barricade ground base' and depth mask 'Mid-right supply barricade' removed; the road now runs south through the gap, world/east-bridge-south-exit)
east-bridge-south.tool: QUILT_QUALITY=93 QUILT_PAINT_MAX=0.03 QUILT_TEXTURE=40 QUILT_MIXED=1 QUILT_PAINT_OPEN=5 QUILT_STEP=32 QUILT_P=64 quilt.py east-bridge mask-east-bridge-south.json src-east-bridge-south.json <out.webp> <original.webp>; no torch on the VPS, so the Poisson blend alone finished the fill (26 px left to the Navier-Stokes fallback). quilt.py gained QUILT_PAINT_MAX (share of marking pixels a source patch may hold).

pins: areas.json and public/world/manifest.json rows for the three layouts and three backdrops; tests/data-areas.test.js pins the new areas.json.
